data.content_ref: inline:Commit to a suspension-stability axiom rather than any new artifact: if a node x is undecided in the grounded extension, then adding any bounded-depth support chain targeting x never flips x to accepted unless x already possesses a defense path of length ≤ k in the original graph; the axiom is checked per graph as an invariant. This turns 'suspension' from a diagnostic label into a protected semantic property. Criticizable: the axiom may block legitimate refinements that ought to turn suspension into acceptance (over-constraining expressiveness); invariant checking over all bounded-depth additions may itself be super-polynomial; the axiom may conflict with reinstatement-as-derived-property in graphs where reinstatement legitimately flips a previously undecided node.
